limitations: Full working tree and Git index, but a focused review scope; this is not full-repository comparison or interaction.
Fresh analysis caches, but checkout/Git reads warm filesystem caches.
One parser worker; default resident source and disabled syntax/input retention options.

Primary latency starts at the browser trusted click and ends after matching DOM, automation observation and two rAF callbacks, not physical presentation. Command elapsed time is retained separately. Finite percentiles do not qualify timing tails.
Native RSS excludes Git children; renderer heap is a point sample, not browser RSS or a 16-GB/editor envelope.
Agent tests/mutations/other benchmarks do not overlap measurement; external host activity is uncontrolled.
